$readme: EDIT THIS FILE TO CHANGE THE DEMO.
GitHub web editor works fine - no rebuild reasoning needed.
Vercel will redeploy automatically on push (~30s).
org: the agency that owns the dashboard.
dealerships: rooftops shown in the demo. Add or rename freely.
samples: review templates. Bucketed by sentiment. Add as many as you like.
- The demo generates 24 reviews per dealership from these samples.
- flags: shown as warning badges in the GM inbox.
For per-prospect demos (Wilson BMW, Metro Auto Group, ...) drop a
JSON file in /prospects/<slug>.json and import it in
